mapper.sql: SELECT e.ENROLL_ID, e.STUDENT_ID, e.COURSE_ID, e.APPLIED_AT, e.STATUS_CD, c.CODE_NAME as STATUS_NAME FROM TB_ENROLL e LEFT JOIN TB_COMMON_CODE c ON c.GROUP_CD = 'ENROLL_STATUS' AND c.CODE = e.STATUS_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ENROLL (STUDENT_ID, COURSE_ID, STATUS_CD) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{statusCd})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_COURSE SET ENROLLED_CNT = ENROLLED_CNT + 1 WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND ENROLLED_CNT < CAPACITY
